name: Muhammad Safi
text: Really thoughtful and helpful article. I appreciate the honest and practical approach to parenting, especially the way these topics are explained with empathy and without judgment. Definitely a worthwhile read for parents!

name: Muhammad Wasi
text: Really enjoyed reading this. It’s thoughtful, practical, and easy to relate to. I especially appreciated how it explains something parents often experience but don’t always know how to put into words. Looking forward to reading more from Nestly Parenting.
